about.title: About the Team Up set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Team Up is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 31 January 2019. It has 196 cards: 181 in the main set and 15 secret rares. There are also 143 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 181 main set cards), the Master set (324 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 339 cards, adding the 15 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
